requirements.title: Applied capstone
requirements.summary: The program overview identifies a capstone applying program learning to a practical problem; course code and credits are not stated.

requirements.title: Language specialization
requirements.summary: Choose a language specialization from: American Sign Language, Chinese, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Korean, or Spanish. Exact language sequences remain unverified.

requirements.title: Mathematical prerequisites
requirements.summary: Mathematical preparation depends on the individual AI+X degree.

requirements.title: Society Core
requirements.summary: Choose five three-credit society courses. Approved options and degree-specific selection rules remain unverified.

requirements.title: Technology Component
requirements.summary: The technology component draws from four-credit mathematics, probability/statistics, computing and data-science courses, combined for the particular degree.

requirements.title: Integrative Courses
requirements.summary: Integrative coursework applies AI or relevant computational and mathematical methods within the partner discipline.

requirements.title: Capstone Experience
requirements.summary: The experiential capstone brings students from AI+X and general AI degrees together on AI-and-society problems.
